resolutions.rationale: Craig directly contests Tooley’s crucial inference from unknown counterbalancing reasons to probable gratuitous suffering by proposing a salvific purpose and a feasible-world comparison.

Craig expressly grants that Muslim experience can provide initial justification, which represents the rival experience charitably, while his claimed defeaters for Islam remain unspecified and asymmetrical.

The only empirical support offered is one missionary email describing post-earthquake revival; Craig provides no verification, baseline, comparison with the disaster’s harms, or evidence that divine action caused the reported conversions.
